structured_output.summary:
P3 stair hall furnished in parts/room-20.mjs: a newel lamp (fence + standing lantern) at the stair foot (44,3..4,10), a hall table (fence + top spruce slab + flower pot) at (42,3..5,13), and two hanging lanterns at (43,6,10) and (43,6,13) under the upper floor. The x43 lane and the entrance cell (42,3..4,10) stay clear.
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with the part's line showing 7 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE.
Light is 9 to 12 at every floor cell (min 11, 0 dark), but the walk check still says no way in because the front door cells at z9 are not built in this copy yet (fittings part); the room check's walk verdict is therefore not yet OK.
left: Walk verdict is not OK yet: `mcd room` reports 0 of 9 floor cells reachable from the entrance, because the double door x41..42 z9 is not in this copy's build (the fittings part). Re-run `mcd room --only "P3 stair hall"` once the front door exists; the lane x43 z10..13 and cell (42,3..4,10) are kept clear for it.
The walk into the room from the back opening (43,3,14) depends on the kitchen-dining part and the stair joiner's foot at (44,3,15); not verified here.

The room is sparse: only two corner cells are free once the lane x43 is kept clear, so there is no bed, chair or shelf here. A chair fits at (42,3,13) only if the hall table moves elsewhere; I left the table because it is the single focal piece the cell can hold.
plan.md and elements.md have no checklist entries for this room, so nothing was ticked.
